title: Rainbow Umbrella
tagline: Peer Support & Affirming Community for LGBTQ+ Youth
audience: Youth ages 13–23 (LGBTQQIAP2+ & questioning individuals and allies)
schedule: Every Friday, 5:30 PM – 7:30 PM (In-person with hybrid options)
location: Diversity Collective Community Resource Center, 2471 Portola Rd, Suite 100, Ventura
summary: Weekly peer support gathering creating a safe harbor for youth to talk openly, build resilience, develop leadership, and form lifelong friendships.
description: Peer support group for individuals who are 13–23, identify as LGBTQQIAP2+ or are discovering/questioning their identities. We provide activities, check-ins, guest speakers, and creative workshops designed to give our youth tools to support their overall mental health and self-expression.
amenities: Weekly facilitated peer-led circle & emotional check-in
Safe space to explore gender identity & sexual orientation
Free snacks, games, art projects, and creative outlets
Organizers of the annual Ventura County Pride Prom
